meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Thailand merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: National Statistical Office of Thailand (NSO) institutional core
reports.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts coordination, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics. Publishes the Statistical Yearbook and major survey series.
reports._notes: Foundational institutional node for the Thai statistical system.
reports._cadence_evidence: The given URL (nso.go.th root) resolves to a language-selection splash carrying only a tagline and navigation images - no publication list, no calendar. The NSO main page behind it names census programmes and refers to a 'ปฏิทินการเผยแพร่ข้อมูล' (data release calendar) but does not state a frequency for the office's own output, so no single cadence is evidenced.

reports.title: Population census and estimates
reports.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. Population is approximately 71–72 million; Thailand is an upper-middle-income economy with advanced demographic transition and rising aging.
reports._cadence_evidence: Same nso.go.th root URL as the institutional node - a language splash with no content. The NSO main page lists a Population and Housing Census among its programmes but gives no census interval and no schedule for the intercensal population estimates, so the page does not establish a frequency.

reports.title: National Accounts of Thailand (GDP)
reports.publisher: Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC) / NSO related
reports.description: Official national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure). Central macro-output series for a diversified upper-middle-income economy with strong tourism, manufacturing and agricultural foundations.
reports._notes: Primary macroeconomic output node. NESDC is the key national accounts compiler.
reports._url_evidence: NESDC National Account hub page: lists National Income of Thailand (NI), Quarterly GDP (QGDP), GPP, capital stock and flow-of-funds series.
reports._cadence_evidence: NESDC national accounts page groups its products under 'สถิติ/ข้อมูลที่เผยแพร่ประจำ' (regularly published statistics) and names Quarterly Gross Domestic Product (ผลิตภัณฑ์มวลรวมในประเทศรายไตรมาส) alongside annual National Income, Gross Regional and Provincial Product, capital stock, flow-of-funds and input-output tables. Quarterly GDP is the finest stated cycle, hence 4; the annual NI and the Gross Regional and Provincial Product series sit at 1 within the same page. Note: this is the only item in the Thai file pointing at NESDC - no five-item shared Gross Regional and Provincial Product page exists in this input; the repeated URLs here are nso.go.th (2 items) and bot.or.th (3 items). No release dates are printed on the page.

reports.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
reports.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates. Thailand has generally maintained low-to-moderate inflation relative to many peers in recent years.
reports._url_evidence: Trade Policy and Strategy Office (Ministry of Commerce) CPI/inflation landing page listing monthly CPI series, regional indices and base-year methodology notes.

reports.title: Bank of Thailand (BOT) institutional and reporting core
reports.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, financial stability, foreign-exchange management and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate, BOP and related series.
reports._cadence_evidence: The given URL (bot.or.th root) is a language-selection splash with no publication content. The BOT statistics section behind it states only generic timing rules across four tiers - daily published every business day, weekly on the last business day of the following week, monthly on the last business day of the following month, quarterly on the last business day of the following quarter - and assigns no cadence to the institution as a whole, so no single number is supportable.

reports.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
reports.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Tourism and goods exports (electronics, vehicles, agriculture) are major credits; the external accounts are a central policy focus.
reports._notes: External-accounts node with important tourism and manufacturing signatures.
reports._cadence_evidence: Same bot.or.th root splash. The external-sector statistics page that carries balance of payments prints no frequency label next to the BOP, trade or external-debt tables - it only announces a June 2026 revision to 26 external-sector tables and refers users to individual table descriptions or an email contact. Frequency not stated on the page.

reports.title: Tourism arrivals and tourism revenue statistics
reports.publisher: Tourism Authority of Thailand / Ministry of Tourism and Sports / related
reports.description: Official statistics on international visitor arrivals and tourism receipts. Tourism is a major services credit in the balance of payments; recent years show arrivals in the low-to-mid 30 millions range and revenue in the multi-trillion-baht range.
reports._notes: High-centrality services and external-earnings node. Core uniqueness for Thailand.
reports._url_evidence: Ministry of Tourism and Sports tourism statistics hub, indexing yearly international tourist arrival and tourism revenue statistics from 2008 to 2026.
reports._cadence_evidence: Ministry of Tourism and Sports category 411 is organised as one entry per year, 'สถิติด้านการท่องเที่ยว ปี X', running from 2008 through 2026 (Thai years 2551-2569), plus a few one-off dated items from 2019. The listing is an annual repository; no monthly or weekly editions appear at this level.

reports.title: Industrial production and manufacturing statistics
reports.description: Industrial production index and manufacturing output statistics. Key segments include automotive, electronics, food, rubber/plastics, petroleum products and related manufactures that underpin export performance.
reports._url_evidence: Office of Industrial Economics 'Industrial Indices' page listing the Production Index, Shipment, Inventory, Labour and Capacity Utilisation indices with downloadable data.

reports.title: Labour force and unemployment statistics
reports.publisher: National Statistical Office / Bank of Thailand related
reports.description: Labour-force participation, employment and unemployment rates from the Labour Force Survey. Unemployment is typically very low by international standards (around or below 1% in recent readings).
reports._notes: Primary labour-market statistical product. Structurally low unemployment.

reports.title: ASEAN merchandise trade statistics
reports.publisher: Bank of Thailand / Ministry of Commerce related
reports.description: Merchandise trade with ASEAN partners. ASEAN is a core regional market and production-network partner for Thai manufacturing and agricultural exports.
reports._url_evidence: Ministry of Commerce official trade statistics report system; provides export/import/balance data with a country-group selection covering ASEAN.
reports._cadence_evidence: MOC tradereport portal is an interactive query system - dashboards by country and product, harmonised-code search, monthly/yearly filters and API endpoints - rather than dated report releases. It links to a 'Statistic Publication Date' page but states no update frequency on this page.
reports.cadence_note: Continuously updated database/portal with no discrete editions. The number is the renderer convention decided 2026-08-18 (HANDOFF section 7) and applied 2026-08-19: a nominal releases_per_year so that absence keeps meaning 'one-off instrument' only - 250 encodes business-day updating (the live corpus's daily-FX convention), 365 genuinely all-days monitoring. It is a statement of continuous flow for the pulse/beam system, not a claim of counted editions - the observed reality is in _cadence_evidence.

reports.title: Agriculture production statistics
reports.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives / NSO related
reports.description: Official volume and value statistics for major crops and livestock. Rice and rubber are the two highest-centrality agricultural commodities; other significant products include sugarcane, cassava, palm oil and fruits.
reports._url_evidence: Office of Agricultural Economics data catalogue entry for 'Agricultural Statistics of Thailand' (annual): area, production, yield, farm-gate prices and land use by province.
reports._cadence_evidence: OAE data catalogue metadata for สถิติการเกษตรของประเทศไทย states 'หน่วยความถี่ของการปรับปรุงข้อมูล: ทุกปี' (update frequency unit: every year). Record last modified 2568 (2025); data last updated 24 March 2564 (2021).

reports.title: Rice production and export statistics
reports.description: Focused statistics on rice production, area and exports. Thailand is a major global rice exporter; the crop remains central to rural livelihoods and food-security framing.
reports._notes: Foundational food and export crop node.
reports._url_evidence: OAE dataset 'ปริมาณการผลิตข้าว': planted/harvested area, production and yield for wet- and dry-season rice by province from 1981; covers production only, not exports.
reports._cadence_evidence: OAE catalogue metadata for ปริมาณการผลิตข้าว (rice production quantity) gives 'หน่วยความถี่ของการปรับปรุงข้อมูล: ปี' (update frequency unit: year). Last updated 1 October 2566 (2023).

reports.title: Natural rubber production and export statistics
reports.description: Statistics on natural rubber planting area, production (dry rubber content) and exports. Thailand is among the world’s largest rubber producers and exporters; the southern region dominates production.
reports._url_evidence: OAE dataset for rubber (ยางพารา): standing area, tapped area, production and yield per rai by province, data from 1988 onward.
reports._cadence_evidence: OAE catalogue metadata for ปริมาณการผลิตยางพารา (rubber production volume) gives update frequency unit 'ปี' with a frequency value of 1, i.e. once a year. Record updated 12 September 2568 (2025); latest data year 2565 (2022).

reports.title: Public debt statistics
reports.publisher: Public Debt Management Office / Ministry of Finance
reports.description: Official statistics on public debt stock, composition (government, SOE, guarantees) and debt-to-GDP ratio. Recent readings place public debt in the mid-60s percent of GDP range.
reports._url_evidence: PDMO public debt outstanding page showing monthly government, SOE, SFI and agency debt plus the debt-to-GDP ratio (63-65%).
reports._cadence_evidence: PDMO debt-outstanding page carries one entry per month in an unbroken run - September 2024 through July 2025 - covering government, state-enterprise and SFI debt plus the debt-to-GDP ratio. No schedule is stated in words; monthly cadence counted from the consecutive dated entries.

reports.title: Bangkok Gross Regional / Provincial Product
reports.publisher: Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC)
reports.description: Official GRDP for Bangkok — the dominant primate-city economy, accounting for a very large share of national GDP through services, finance, trade, tourism and headquarters activity.
reports._notes: Primary primate-city economic node. Highest single provincial share.
reports._url_evidence: NESDC Gross Regional and Provincial Product (chain volume measures) series page with reports and Excel time series covering all provinces including Bangkok; no province-specific landing page exists.

reports.title: Electricity generation and capacity statistics
reports.publisher: Energy Policy and Planning Office / EGAT related
reports.description: Installed generation capacity, power generation by fuel type, peak demand and consumption statistics. Natural gas, coal, hydro, renewables and imports form the mix; power is a critical infrastructure series for industry and tourism.
reports._url_evidence: EPPO electricity statistics page covering capacity, generation, peak demand, consumption, import/export and fuel used.
reports._cadence_evidence: EPPO electricity statistics page publishes capacity, generation, peak, consumption, import/export and fuel-used tables with Current / Monthly / Yearly views and downloadable exports, the latest being 'Current 2026 (6 month)'. Monthly is the finest published table cycle; the page itself states no release schedule beyond the monthly view.

reports.title: Banking system structure and credit statistics
reports.description: Statistics on the structure of the banking system, total assets, credit aggregates and related indicators. The system is assessed as resilient with solid capital and liquidity buffers.
reports._cadence_evidence: Same bot.or.th root splash. The BOT financial-institutions statistics page lists the Summary Statement of Assets and Liabilities and the Commercial Banks' Report on Deposits and Credits by District but attaches no monthly/quarterly/annual label to either and refers users to a contact email for schedules.

reports.title: Non-performing loans and banking asset-quality statistics
reports.description: System-wide NPL (Stage 3) ratios and volumes. Recent readings place the NPL ratio in the high-2% range; asset quality is closely monitored under SME and consumer credit pressures.
reports._notes: Core asset-quality / risk node for the banking cluster.
reports._url_evidence: Bank of Thailand 'Financial Institutions' statistics category, described on the BOT statistics index as covering financial institutions' loans, deposits, financial status and non-performing loans (NPLs); BOT publishes no separate NPL-only landing page.

reports.title: Education enrolment and attainment statistics
reports.publisher: National Statistical Office / Ministry of Education related
reports.description: Official statistics on enrolment rates by level and related attainment indicators. Primary enrolment is near-universal; secondary and tertiary participation form the main human-capital expansion margins.
reports._notes: Core education access and human-capital node.

reports.title: Poverty and living standards statistics
reports.description: Official and compiled poverty rates and living-standards indicators. National poverty has declined to low single digits on some measures; upper-middle-income poverty lines still show residual double-digit shares, with regional disparities.
reports._url_evidence: NSO household income/expenditure indicator branch listing the poverty line, poverty incidence and number of poor, sourced from NESDC.
reports._cadence_evidence: NSO statistics branch 309 (household income and expenditure) lists ten series - household income, expenditure, debt, poverty line, share and number of poor, Gini coefficients - each as annual observations, with coverage 2547-2566 and 2555-2566 and dissemination dates of 10 October 2567 and 25 December 2568. Annual counted from the yearly data points; no periodicity is stated in words.

reports.title: Life expectancy and vital statistics
reports.description: Official life expectancy at birth and related vital statistics. Female life expectancy is around 80 years; male around 72 years in recent readings. Thailand has completed the demographic transition and is aging.
reports._url_evidence: NSO demographic/population indicator branch listing life expectancy at birth (and at 60/65/80), birth and death registrations and the total fertility rate.
reports._cadence_evidence: NSO statistics branch 300 lists vital and health indicators - population registration, births, deaths, life expectancy, fertility - as yearly series covering 2553-2568, with the most recent release dated 17 April 2569. Annual counted from the yearly data points and single annual release date; no explicit frequency statement.

reports.title: Chonburi Gross Provincial Product
reports.publisher: Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC)
reports.description: Official GPP for Chonburi — a core Eastern Economic Corridor province combining deep-sea port (Laem Chabang), industrial estates, automotive and logistics with tourism (Pattaya). Consistently among the largest provincial economies after Bangkok.
reports._url_evidence: NESDC Gross Regional and Provincial Product series page (reports plus Excel time series by province, 1995 onward) covering Chonburi; NESDC publishes no per-province landing page.

reports.title: Rayong Gross Provincial Product
reports.description: Official GPP for Rayong — the industrial heart of the EEC, anchored by Map Ta Phut petrochemical complex, refineries and heavy industry. Frequently ranks among the highest in GPP per capita.
reports._url_evidence: NESDC Gross Regional and Provincial Product series page (reports plus Excel time series by province, 1995 onward) covering Rayong; NESDC publishes no per-province landing page.

reports.title: Chiang Mai Gross Provincial Product
reports.description: Official GPP for Chiang Mai — the principal northern urban and tourism/services pole, ranking among the larger provincial economies outside the Central–Eastern core.
reports._url_evidence: NESDC Gross Regional and Provincial Product series page (reports plus Excel time series by province, 1995 onward) covering Chiang Mai; NESDC publishes no per-province landing page.

reports.title: Phuket Gross Provincial Product
reports.description: Official GPP for Phuket — the principal southern island tourism economy. Highly sensitive to international visitor arrivals and a key node in the national tourism statistics.
reports._url_evidence: NESDC Gross Regional and Provincial Product series page (reports plus Excel time series by province, 1995 onward) covering Phuket; NESDC publishes no per-province landing page.

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

2026-08-19: the 35 records resolved 'continuous-database' were given a nominal releases_per_year (250 business-day portals/feeds/query databases; 365 all-days monitoring: air quality, volcano/seismic, tropical-cyclone, disaster-event feeds), each with a cadence_note naming the convention. Original delivered value untouched in _cadence_original; evidence untouched in _cadence_evidence.

domain_semantic_pass.merged_into_existing: Synonyms folded into the 22 already-approved tags (prices→inflation, employment→labour, demography/census→population, monetary/central-bank→monetary-policy, gdp/grdp/regional-accounts→national-accounts, and so on).
domain_semantic_pass.promoted: 17 tags that had earned a slot were promoted out of proposed: and added to Domain in types.ts.
domain_semantic_pass.dropped: Geographic pseudo-tags (regional, provincial, urban, municipal, metropolitan) and batch-meta pseudo-tags (comprehensive, multi-domain, meta, indicators) were removed — geography is already carried by region and jurisdiction_level, and the meta ones describe the batch rather than the report.

url_research_pass.method: Per-country web research. A URL was accepted only when the page was actually retrieved and its content confirmed the publication. Publisher homepages, Wikipedia, news, aggregators and mirrors were rejected. Confirmations are stored on each node as _url_evidence.

grok_pass.asked: 75 items (34 with no URL, 41 with only a series-level URL)
grok_pass.result: Grok recovered 1 of the 34, independently reproduced all 41 series-level URLs, and returned the other 33 as dead for the same reasons Claude hit.

cadence_research_pass.method: Each node's own verified URL was fetched and the release frequency read off the page — a stated periodicity, an advance release calendar, or a count of dated editions. Numbers carry their evidence in _cadence_evidence. Nothing was inferred from the title alone, and Grok's original text is preserved in _cadence_original.
